source.title: Our Top Charities

benchmark.name: GiveWell benchmark
benchmark.description: Consumption-based benchmark for people living at the $2.15/day 2017 PPP poverty line; GiveDirectly is no longer the benchmark.

source.coverageNote: Top-charity cost-per-life figures are GiveWell's reported 2022–2024 directed-funding averages. They are not the bottom-line outputs of the newer location-specific models and should not be used as current funding-tranche estimates.

opportunities.evidenceNote: Many high-quality studies consistently find strong impact; GiveWell also highlights Malaria Consortium's ongoing monitoring.
opportunities.fundingRoomNote: Current organization-level funding room is not published on the Top Charities page; GiveWell allocates Top Charities Fund donations to the highest-impact current opportunities within six months.
opportunities.limitations: Country-level cost-effectiveness varies materially; the headline average is historical and the model is extremely rough.

geographies: Low- and middle-income countries with verified campaign funding gaps
opportunities.evidenceNote: Many high-quality studies consistently find strong impact; GiveWell notes uncertainty about protection duration and insecticide resistance.
opportunities.modelVersion: Current public ITN CEA linked May 2026
opportunities.fundingRoomNote: AMF and GiveWell assess campaign-specific gaps and other funders' likely contributions; no current aggregate donor-facing gap is published on the Top Charities page.
opportunities.limitations: Headline average is historical; campaign location, other-funder behavior, net durability, and insecticide resistance affect marginal impact.

opportunities.evidenceNote: Many high-quality studies show strong impact, though results vary; GiveWell highlights monitoring uncertainty.
opportunities.fundingRoomNote: Helen Keller shares annual country-level room-for-more-funding reports; the latest report linked from GiveWell's review is 2023, so no current numeric gap is inferred.
opportunities.limitations: Headline average is historical; country results vary and evidence may transfer imperfectly to current child-health conditions.

opportunities.program: Cash incentives for routine childhood vaccination
opportunities.evidenceNote: A high-quality randomized study found strong impact; GiveWell highlights detailed ongoing monitoring and scale-up risk.
opportunities.fundingRoomNote: GiveWell evaluates expansion by state and does not publish a current aggregate donor-facing funding gap on the Top Charities page.
opportunities.limitations: Headline average is historical; state-level vaccination rates, costs, counterfactual uptake, fraud risk, and expansion quality vary.
